title: Eleven Floors and One Man
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：office　|　正文 389 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 office 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My first job in a city was on the ninth floor of a building with eleven, in an ① office with no windows, doing work that had no output I could name. I lasted four months. What I remember is not the work but the lift, and the man who ran it, and the fact that the ② office of the whole enterprise turned out to be one room on the ground floor that nobody had told me about.

The lift man was called Arthur and he had been there nineteen years. His ③ office, as he described it, was a stool, a mirror and a radio, and he took the definition seriously: he was on duty at seven, he was ④ in office until six, and he knew which floor everybody got off at and never said so. He was, I now think, the only person in the building doing the job as described.

The office, I later learned, had eleven floors and two entrances. Upstairs, the language was different. People spoke of 'the ⑤ office' meaning the whole firm, and of 'out of ⑥ office' meaning gone for eleven minutes to buy a sandwich. Nobody used the word to mean anything they were answerable for, which is the sense I had grown up with and the one my mother used when she said a person's ⑦ office is to do the thing properly, whether or not anybody is watching.

In March the firm moved to a building with glass on every floor. Arthur was offered a ⑧ office job at a desk, took it, and left in six weeks. He said the difficulty was not the work but the mirror: without it he could not tell when somebody was about to speak to him, and in a city that is a ⑨ matter of some office, because being spoken to first is half of what a doorman is for.

I left in April and have worked in seven buildings since, none of which had a lift man and all of which called themselves an office. The ⑩ office of noticing people, I have concluded, was never written into anybody's contract, and it is the only job in that building I would now take. Arthur wrote to me once, in 2011, to say the glass building had been sold, and that he had been right about the mirror.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 办公室；办公处所
B. n. （机构的）办事处；事务所；营业处
C. n. 公职；官职；职务
D. n. 职责；本分；义务（one's office）
E. 固定搭配：in office 在任；当值（此处指值班）
F. 固定搭配：out of office 不在办公室；外出
G. adj. 办公室的；坐办公室的（office job）
H. n. （泛指的）公司；全体职员（the office）

items.q: in an office with no windows
the office of the whole enterprise turned out to be one room
His office, as he described it, was a stool, a mirror and a radio
he was in office until six
People spoke of 'the office' meaning the whole firm
and of 'out of office' meaning gone for eleven minutes
a person's office is to do the thing properly
Arthur was offered a office job at a desk
in a city that is a matter of some office
The office of noticing people, I have concluded, was never written into anybody's contract

answers.why: 指没有窗户的那间“办公室”，我的第一份工作就在里面。
指整个企业的“办公处所、总部所在”，其实是底楼一间没人告诉我的屋子。
指他的“办公处”，即一只凳子、一面镜子和一台收音机，带有自嘲。
in office 此处意为“在岗、当值”，说他七点上班、六点前一直在岗。
the office 泛指“公司、全体职员”，说人们用这个词指整个企业。
out of office 意为“不在办公室、外出”，说人们用这个词指出去买个三明治的十一分钟。
one's office 意为“某人的职责、本分”，说母亲认为把事情做对是人的本分。
office job 意为“坐办公室的工作”，说 Arthur 被安排去坐办公桌。
matter of office 意为“职责范围内的事、职务上的事”，说先被人开口是门房的职责所在。
the office of doing 意为“做……的职责”，说留意他人这项职责从来没写进任何人的合同。
